name: CrateDB
label: CrateDB HTTP — POST /_sql
description: Official CrateDB HTTP SQL. POST /_sql with JSON stmt and args (table.insert also bulk_args). Default http://localhost:4200; edit api_spec.baseUrl for the cluster (engine cannot bind host). Handler: OfficialApiNode. HTTP Basic username+password. Customer owns the cluster. password is never logged or returned.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Both ops require stmt. execute.sql optional args. table.insert optional args or bulk_args (list of arg lists). Do not put password here. Example: {"operation":"execute.sql","stmt":"SELECT 1","args":[]}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'execute.sql' | 'table.insert'.

schema.label: stmt
schema.description: SQL with ? or $1 placeholders. Official JSON key stmt.

schema.label: args
schema.description: Parameter array for one execution. Official JSON key args.

schema.label: bulk_args
schema.description: List of arg lists for table.insert bulk INSERT. Official JSON key bulk_args. Bulk cannot return result sets.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (cols/rows/rowcount). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: execute.sql | table.insert.

configurationParameters.label: Username
configurationParameters.description: HTTP Basic username. Default CrateDB user is often 'crate'.

configurationParameters.label: Password
configurationParameters.description: HTTP Basic password (StudioQuack secret). Never log or place on INPUT. Must be non-empty even if the cluster uses trust auth.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
